turns.question: How much revenue did we make per site session between 20 September and 3 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no revenue-per-session metric, so I won't divide the two myself; the closest metrics give, for 20 September to 3 October 2026, Revenue (EUR) of 7172.59 EUR and Site sessions of 10 sessions.
